_contract: Tokenizer fixture (architecture review 2026-07-29, candidate #6; the Rust twin was deleted 2026-10-06, ADR-079). src/utils/__tests__/TextTokenizer.parity.test.ts asserts TextTokenizer.tokenize against `expected`. Do not edit an expectation to make a test pass: change the tokenizer, or record the behaviour on purpose.

cases.name: latin_word
cases.description: An entire run of ASCII letters is one token.

cases.name: number
cases.description: An entire run of ASCII digits is one token.

cases.name: whitespace_run
cases.description: A run of whitespace is one token, distinct from the words around it.

cases.name: ascii_punctuation
cases.description: A single ASCII punctuation character is a punctuation token.

cases.name: decimal_point_splits_number
cases.description: A decimal point splits a number: number, punctuation, number.

cases.name: punctuation_is_one_token_per_character
cases.description: Punctuation is never grouped: a run of two ellipsis characters is two tokens, so the punctuation dictionary's single-character keys match each one.

cases.name: compatibility_ideographs_are_chinese_char
cases.description: CJK Compatibility Ideographs (U+F900-FAFF) are chinese_char; NFC maps U+F900 to U+8C48 before tokenizing.

cases.name: underscore_is_punctuation
cases.description: An underscore is punctuation, one token per underscore.

cases.name: bom_is_punctuation
cases.description: U+FEFF is punctuation: Unicode White_Space does not include it.
